v1.name: V1 readiness
v1.status: Supervised pilot: form and security fixes merged; premium AWS skill delivery and live release verification missing
v1.summary: Oct 31 BusinessBuilder main 817d513a is CodeBuild-green and contains merged #833 safe form check, #853 authentication/private-link fixes, and #885 team-chat safety and understanding repairs (PR reports 97.7% blind owner evaluation and 162/162 attack cases). These are code/test improvements, not verified production behavior. Stromation main 01fbcd79 still has #331 skill engine default-off; no full accepted Fargate/Chromium AWS site with settled cost, three approved publish/export handoffs, repeated unattended recovery or timed restore was verified.

v2.name: V2 readiness
v2.status: Five-worker bench and guarded chat improvements merged; real-provider recurring outcomes not demonstrated
v2.summary: BusinessBuilder #885 substantially improves chat safety/intent on offline and model-backed probes; #891 repairs Maya practice model routing but production activation is still unverified. Prior #829 five-worker benchmark uses simulated external providers, with no repeated all-five real-provider outcomes, delivered recap, activated essential integrations or unattended operating results.

v3.name: V3 / Full 10/10 vision
v3.status: Material security/form code fixes merged; premium delivery, SaaS/custom agents, production autonomy and economics unproven
v3.summary: Merged #833/#853/#885 reduce documented form-inbox, sign-in/session/privacy and chat guard risks, with green main CI but no independently established production rollout. The premium skill is off/unproven on Fargate; complete SaaS and custom-agent delivery, 95–99% representative routine workflow autonomy, settled margins and 1–2 founder technical hours/week have not been measured.

autonomyProof.note: Representative success/attempt denominator is still unavailable; do not imply the 95–99% V3 mature target has been measured.

founderWorkload.note: Darius minutes are not comprehensively separated from operator effort, customer approvals or specialist review.
